description: Surgical edits to the pristine Theater 1.10.0 search.chunk.js. Fork mod ported from the 1.9.2 baseline during the 2026-10 re-baseline (previously baked into upstream/theater-1.9.2/search.chunk.js).

ops.note: Search input mirror: poll the (possibly virtual) keyboard's value changes into the app's query setter P() — the VIDAA keyboard sets input.value without firing the events the app listens to. Cleared on unmount via the same lifecycle the app uses (a.Ki).
